title: Action potential: clinical relevance (R-10015)
description: Action potential is a neural process of the nervous system. Its role: an electrical impulse traveling down the axon, fired when the membrane passes threshold from its resting state near -70 mV. Closely associated with axon, ion channels, and threshold. Clinicians watch Action potential because disorders of neural signaling trace back to it. Key fact: an all-or-nothing signaling event.
